alt: The Ford 'FATHOM' name badge — white letters spelling FATHOM™ on a black rectangular metal plate against a dark textured background — the entire visual announcement for Ford's declared 'Model T moment'
story: Ford CEO Jim Farley announced on August 6, 2026 that the 'Fathom,' a $28,350 electric pickup truck, represents Ford's 'Model T moment' and 'breakthrough electric vehicle' — but the actual truck design won't be revealed until early 2027, so the announcement image is literally just the name badge on a black surface while critics said the compact pickup doesn't address the right market.
why_funny: Ford declared a historic 'Model T moment' for a truck they are not yet allowed to show anyone, which means their generation-defining breakthrough currently looks like a hotel room safe.
